newsitem.title: USA: Dominion calls committee plan unworkable.
newsitem.headline: Dominion calls committee plan unworkable.

text.p: Dominion Bridge Corp said Tuesday proposals by a shareholders group to increase shareholders value are "misleading and unworkable."

The group, also known as the Committee to Revitalize Dominion Bridge, proposed July 2 the company buy First Key Project Technologies Inc of Toronto; buy the remainder of its Australian McConnell Dowell subsidiary; and issue shareholder contingent value rights for $2.50 a share.

Dominion said Tuesday First Key is a startup company with no track record. It also said Australian laws pose limitations on privatizations and questioned the committee's ability to raise the $45 million acquisition price of McConnell.
